_readme: Every source DeviceScout knows about. Run `devicescout check` on a machine with internet access first:
it detects each store's platform (Shopify / WooCommerce / JSON-LD), pulls one sample product, and reports OK/FAIL.
verified=false means the adapter follows the site's platform conventions but has not been run against the live site yet.
region: np = buyable in Nepal (NPR) | np-ref = Nepali listed/official price, not a shop | intl = reference only.
Check each site's terms of service and robots.txt before scraping it at scale; keep delays polite.

sources.name: gadgetbyte
sources.notes: Nepal's main tech site: official launch prices and specs for each model (not a shop). Pages like /samsung-galaxy-a56-price-in-nepal/.

sources.name: hukut
sources.notes: Whole store: no product sitemap, so every category, brand, offer and next page is walked (start_urls are just where the walk begins). JavaScript-built pages: rendered in the browser scrapers.

sources.name: gsmarena
sources.notes: Most complete phone/tablet/watch spec database. Specs only, no prices.

sources.name: brother-mart
sources.notes: /collections/ URLs suggest Shopify; `check` confirms. Add more collection handles after checking.

sources.name: itechstore
sources.notes: Says it is an authorised distributor for Apple/HP/Lenovo/Dell; set "official": true once confirmed.

sources.name: notebookcheck
sources.notes: Independent lab reviews of laptops and phones; review score -> expert_score (answers 'is it actually good', which specs cannot).

sources.name: dxomark
sources.notes: Camera/display/battery lab scores; key for the photography profile. JS-heavy: needs fetch_mode dynamic and a custom parser before enabling.

sources.name: samsung-in
sources.notes: Official India prices (NPR is pegged to INR at 1.6) to judge whether a Nepali price is fair. Enable after reviewing Samsung's terms.
